long.title: Amsterdam by Train 🚆 Tulip Season Spring Afternoon Lofi Window Ride | 5-Minute Chillhop Journey
long.summary: Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride through an illustrated Amsterdam on a breezy spring afternoon in tulip season: canals lined with tall gabled houses, hump-backed bridges with flower boxes, bicycles and tulips, and windmills over striped tulip fields, with mellow chillhop the whole way.

short_1.title: Train ride along an Amsterdam canal in tulip season 🌷 #lofi #amsterdam #shorts
short_1.summary: A canal bridge and tall gabled canal houses on a bright spring afternoon, then a ride past bicycles and tulips, with mellow lofi beats.

short_2.title: Lofi train window: windmills, tulips and canal houses 🌷 #lofi #amsterdam #shorts
short_2.summary: Windmills over the tulip fields behind a row of Amsterdam canal houses, with bicycles and tulips along the water and mellow lofi beats.
